summary: Browse offline SRD references and manage tabletop combat.
page_description: Offline SRD reference and table tools for spell lookups, monster stat blocks, dice, initiative, and party HP.
release_notes: Every party member now opens their own page, not only the first one tapped. Stat blocks read like a printed book, with armor, senses and challenge ratings such as 1/4, and spells show their range, components and duration.
